plugins.name: make-it-work
plugins.description: AI-assisted SDLC workflows for established codebases: map project context, shape and slice requirements, refine tickets, plan implementation, and review pull requests against documented intent.

skills.name: close-the-gaps
skills.description: Refines a requirement into an AI-ready ticket: a Product Analyst session that fetches the ticket, loads project skills, explores affected code, asks gap-analysis questions one at a time, and outputs a Gherkin-format refined ticket. Use when refining a ticket before dev starts.

skills.name: go-deep
skills.description: Makes any codebase AI-ready with a 3-tier doc system (CLAUDE.md, orientation maps, domain & UC skills). Use when onboarding a project to Claude Code or auditing/updating existing docs after the project evolves.

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Turns a spec or refined ticket into a concrete, execution-ready implementation plan — the plan step of the spec → plan → execute → review pipeline. Loads the project's skills, investigates the affected code across one or more repos, and writes an atomic, per-step plan file with no placeholders. Use when planning how to implement a ticket, epic, or spec before any code is written.
headings: Step 1 — Locate the workspace and the spec
Step 4.5 — Resolve open questions & confirm approach (interactive)

skills.name: review-the-pr
skills.description: Reviews a pull request in three documentation-grounded passes (business correctness, regression safety, coding standards) and emits an evidence-dense, verdict-first report. Use when reviewing a PR or diff in any repo that keeps CLAUDE.md plus uc-*/domain-* skills and .claude/rules docs.
headings: Step 0 — Ask for the PR link first
Step 2 — Load the skills that match the diff

skills.name: shape-the-epic
skills.description: Turns a rough idea into a complete, elaboration-ready epic via a guided interview session, PM-coach style. Use when writing or improving a product epic, drafting acceptance criteria, or documenting a feature for engineering.

skills.name: slice-the-epic
skills.description: Slices a large requirement into small, AI-ready, value-driven slices. Use when the user asks to split, slice, right-size, or write stories from a requirement.
